text:
samir: quick note — noticed a spike where imported leads dropped to overflow despite SDR capacity. looks like enrichment latency + tight claim TTL.

hannah: saw ~15 hits during the EU CSV import window, enrichment callbacks often >30s. claim_ttl is 18s currently so fallback is happening too fast.

diego: suggestion: per-route "import_grace" that keeps a pending state for X ms after claim expiry; if enrichment returns within that window and passes guards, auto-reassign to original owner. opt-in per route so realtime unaffected.

meera: guards: enrichment.confidence >= 0.6, enrichment.source in [\"hubspot_bulk\", \"hs_csv_v3\"], SF.last_activity < enrichment.timestamp, and per-rep reassign_rate_limit=3/hr.

samir: config example for canary (2% imports):

```json
{"route":"csv-import","claim_ttl_ms":18000,"enrichment_timeout_ms":30000,"fallback_policy":"deferred_reassign","deferred_window_ms":40000}
```

hannah: also log event types: claim_acquire, claim_expire, deferred_candidate, reassign_attempt, reassign_result. include enrichment_version in logs.

diego: runbook snippet for support: 1) check routing events for claim_acquire/expire 2) check enrichment latency and source 3) check deferred_candidate/reassign logs 4) check SF last_activity 5) manual reassign steps if auto-reassign off.

meera: monitoring: deferred_candidates, reassign_success_rate, overflow_rate_imports. alert if reassign_failure_rate > 5% or overflow_rate doesn't drop within 6h.

samir: I'll file the PR and include rollback toggle + migration. Hannah will own dashboard. Diego will draft runbook.

hs-bot: HubSpot: bulk import contact 00f77 updated (enrichment latency 39s) event=evt_3021

hannah: perfect example — candidate for deferred_reassign if canary on. starting canary at 02:00 UTC for 6h. will report 3h/6h metrics. :eyes:

diego: tagging support rota for awareness @support-team

meera: tiny follow-up — when auto-reassign happens, only perform if SF.owner_last_action_ts < enrichment.timestamp to avoid stomping active reps. rate-limit notifications to avoid inbox spam.

samir: agreed. PR link when ready.
